editionLabel: Sand Castle Games English base game
firstPlayerRule: Choose a First Player and give them the First Player token. After collecting essences, that player takes the first action.
clarifications: During setup, players choose magic items counterclockwise starting with the player to the First Player’s right; the First Player chooses last.
Essences are normally collected simultaneously. Any player may request clockwise collection starting with the First Player.
Action turns proceed clockwise. The first player to pass takes the First Player token for the next round.
